property_summary: Calls to sendTo revert for any caller who is not the contract owner; i.e., if the caller is not owner then reverted must be true.
If InvMutTest (this contract) is not the owner of c, then calling c.sendTo(...) from this contract must revert (i.e., reverted == true).

For all callers, invoking sendTo transfers out funds only when called by the stored owner; the mutant that removes the owner check allows non-owner callers to make sendTo succeed and thus can change contract balance for some inputs.
Calling sendTo with a receiver that rejects/consumes incoming transfers must revert (so the call cannot silently fail).
For any nonzero positive amount and any nonzero receiver, calling sendTo must not revert (i.e., always succeed) when invoked by the owner.
If receiver is not the zero address and amount > 0, then sendTo should NOT revert.

For any caller who is the owner and any non-zero receiver and positive amount funded to the contract, invoking sendTo transfers ETH out so that the contract's balance decreases by the amount (reference always reverts on failure with transfer), whereas the mutant using .send can silently fail causing the contract balance to not decrease for some inputs (failing callee), thus breaking the property.
